I didn't find the official ycombinator.com/companies listing in the results. The sources are third-party trackers, and their counts disagree widely (from 56 to 243 companies), so treat the numbers as rough.

- **Size:** One tracker lists 243 S26 startups and says it syncs daily from ycombinator.com ([ycstartups.co](https://ycstartups.co/summer-2026)). Another directory counts 233 ([roundfunded](https://www.roundfunded.com/en/yc-startups/summer-2026)). A third article, written after Demo Day, reports 235 companies and calls it the largest batch in YC's history ([foundra](https://www.foundra.ai/key-reads/yc-s26-demo-day-agent-infrastructure-founder-strategy-2026)). The 56-company figure comes from a "deep dive" post that appears to cover only a subset ([precize](https://www.precize.in/blogs/yc-s26-companies-y-combinator-summer-2026-startups)).
- **AI focus:** Sources describe AI spreading beyond chatbots into robotics, cybersecurity, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and semiconductors ([precize](https://www.precize.in/blogs/yc-s26-companies-y-combinator-summer-2026-startups)). One tracker estimates that YC's 2026 batches are roughly 60% AI companies ([agentjesse](https://agentjesse.ai/lists/y-combinator-w26-s26-companies-to-watch-in-2026)).
- **Example companies:** Trackers list AI-focused S26 names such as Conifer (local-first model routing), Context.dev (structured web data for agents), Zomma (computer-use agents for enterprises), and Alloovium (document intelligence for construction) ([tldl](https://www.tldl.io/blog/yc-ai-startups-2026), [extruct](https://www.extruct.ai/data-room/ycombinator-companies-s26/)).
- **Timing conflict:** One page says Demo Day was scheduled for September 10, 2026 ([agentjesse](https://agentjesse.ai/lists/y-combinator-w26-s26-companies-to-watch-in-2026)). A later article describes the Demo Day as already held, so the list may be finalized now.

For the authoritative list, check ycombinator.com/companies with the S26 filter.

content.content:
1. **Tsenta**: Automates job applications by monitoring company career pages and submitting tailored applications for job seekers.
2. **Archal**: Tests autonomous software agents against clones of real services, recording traces and evidence for review.
3. **Control Seat**: Adds an AI analytics and automation layer on top of existing industrial SCADA systems.
4. **Codag**: Compresses raw logs into structured incident summaries so AI debugging agents can use them.
5. **Rex** (UK): Runs AI agents for enterprise order-to-cash work, including inbox triage, cash application, and dispute tracking.
6. **Context.dev**: Offers a web data API that gives AI agents and LLM pipelines structured data from websites.
7. **RealPact**: Uses AI agents to pull property data and draft, review, and send real estate contracts.
8. **Glen**: Provides a shared memory layer that lets AI agents read and write organization-wide knowledge.
9. **Mireye**: Gives AI agents sourced geospatial data for US locations through an API and MCP server.
10. **Perceptron ML**: Builds an event-driven engine that triggers automated responses to real-world signals like RFPs or regulatory filings.
